reviews.title: The Lg 27g640a-b is a great choice for 1440p gaming at high FPS.
reviews.comment: Amazing monitor from Lg, great picture quality with crisp colors and nice blacks just make sure to adjust the sleep mode in the energy saving setting since it’s a little aggressive and will make the screen go black in a few minutes of inactivity. Bought during Black Friday sale and for 269.00 this monitor provides everything you need for modern gaming and multitasking (if not picking this one up you might as well go for 4K). Good connectivity with not only display port but hdmi 2.1 as well for those playing on console or even for dual pc/console setups also this product comes with built-in speakers which are not the best in sound quality but is a nice addition to have. 1440p at a maximum of 300 hz makes this monitor a no brainer definitely recommend this product. I’ll keep updating this review if needed but as of now I’m more than satisfied with my purchase.
reviews.author: JJ

reviews.title: Great monitor
reviews.comment: This LG monitor has met or exceeded all my expectations.  There are not any professional reviews, but I took a chance on it.  Good color, more than bright enough for my darkish room. The stand is sturdy and stronger than I expected. Speakers probably aren't great, but I never planned on using them anyway.  300hz and Freesync for $266 is a great deal. My only negative might be the included DP cable.  The monitor would not turn on with it, I thought it was DOA.  I tried the DP cable from my old monitor, and it worked.  I'd highly recommend this monitor for high refresh rate 1440p gaming.
reviews.author: Fred

reviews.title: Great Value for a Great Monitor (if 40% off or more)
reviews.comment:
Great value for a great monitor. Caught this at 50% off and gambled on international shipping. Even with customs getting their hands in and inspecting it still arrived fully functional (way to go LG).
Great performance and features, nice brightness, pretty good panel, haven't done any blurriness tests but haven't noticed any issues in a week of watching videos coding and gaming.
Real good connectivity, comes with HDMI and DP cables (nice) and does include speakers, although the sound quality can be better (a lot better, like it sounds worse than some old stereo speakers I got from 15+ years ago) it's still nice to have if you don't wanna wear your headsets all day.
Pretty satisfied, will update if anything happens
reviews.author: Carlos

reviews.title: Good IPS monitor, Speakers okay, Great Value
reviews.comment: Best IPS monitor I ever bought, compared to my previous one, this one stands out. I would recommend buying this monitor if it's around $225-$250. Speakers aren't great but you shouldn't be buying it for speakers anyways!
reviews.author: Fru

reviews.title: Great monitor with some minor nitpicks.
reviews.comment: Bought three of these about a month ago, only one of them has developed a singular pixel that gets stuck sometimes. The viewing angles are pretty bad, but it isn't really a factor when you're sitting down in front of them. The screens are unfortunately some kind of semi-gloss instead of being fully matte, so they reflect light from each other quite easily. If I have one turned off and look at it from an angle I can see the middle screen in it, for instance. Playing games with all three of them though, this is never something you notice, these are nitpicks more than anything else. The stands are extremely durable but they do shake easily, so if you need them to not shake then get different stands. The included cables all work well. They are pretty bright. Nothing major to complain about.
reviews.author: Carter Prescott
